lines.en: label day54:
scene hall_day
I exit the teachers’ lounge and make my way into the hall, avoiding eye contact with anyone I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我走出教师休息室，来到走廊，避开所有我不认识的人的目光。

lines.en: Despite how ‘comfortable’ I’ve gotten around my class, I still feel slightly odd surrounded by students I haven’t met yet.
lines.zh: 尽管我在自己班上已经「自在」了不少，但被还没见过的学生围着，还是让我有点别扭。

lines.en: I keep subconsciously thinking they’re going to realize I’m not {i}actually{/i} a teacher and call the cops on me or something.
lines.zh: 我总在潜意识里觉得，他们会发现我{i}其实{/i}根本不是老师，然后报警什么的。

lines.en: Obviously, the likelihood of that happening is very slim. But the thought is still there and that alone is enough to cause a bit of unrest in this misguided head of mine.
lines.zh: 显然，这种事发生的可能性非常小。但这个念头就摆在那儿，光是这一点，就足以让我这颗不靠谱的脑袋有点不安。

lines.en: scene black
I round the corner and duck into the cafeteria to grab a quick bite to eat before the second half of the day begins.
lines.zh: 我转过弯，钻进食堂，想在下午的课开始之前赶紧吃上一口。

lines.en: Not wanting to wait in line for hot food, I buy a few snacks out of a vending machine and begin to head back to class.
lines.zh: 不想排队等热食，我从自动贩卖机买了几包零食，准备回教室。

lines.en: As is customary around here, though...I’m flagged down before I’m able to do that.
lines.zh: 不过，按照这里的惯例……我还没走成，就被人拦下了。

lines.en: scene ayalunch1
: Sensei! Do you want to eat lunch with us today? Everybody else went out to eat in the courtyard, so it'll just be Sana and me.
lines.zh: : 老师！今天要不要跟我们一起吃午饭？其他人都去院子里吃了，所以就只有我和 Sana。

lines.en: : What? Why didn't you two go with them?
lines.zh: : 什么？你们两个怎么没跟她们一起去？

lines.en: : It's...too hot out there...
lines.zh: : 外面……太热了……

lines.en: : I would...probably die...
lines.zh: : 我大概……会死……

lines.en: : What Sana said. I don't want her death to be on my hands, so I've decided to take one for the team and eat in here instead.
lines.zh: : Sana 说得对。我可不想让她死在我手上，所以我决定为团队牺牲一下，在屋里吃。

lines.en: : I'm glad I did, though! Because this decision meant I got to see your face! And that your face will now join us for lunch!
lines.zh: : 不过我很高兴我这么做了！因为这个决定让我见到了你的脸！而现在这张脸要跟我们一起吃午饭了！

lines.en: : I mean...I was planning on going back to the teacher’s lounge and eating in there.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我本来打算回教师休息室在里面吃的。

lines.en: : But?
lines.zh: : 但是？

lines.en: : ...But I guess I can hang out here instead.
lines.zh: : ……但我想我也可以留在这儿。

lines.en: scene ayalunch2
: Woohoo!
lines.zh: : 哇呼！

lines.en: : Umm...yay?...
: Yay indeed, Sana. Yay indeed...
lines.zh: : 确实是「耶」，Sana。确实是「耶」……

lines.en: : Are you...not that hungry, Sensei?...All you have on your tray are...snacks...
lines.zh: : 老师……你不太饿吗？……你餐盘里只有……零食……

lines.en: Sana takes a quick glance at the minor haul I was able to procure today before taking a sip of her ramune.
lines.zh: Sana 快速瞥了一眼我今天弄到手的那一小堆东西，然后喝了一口弹珠汽水。

lines.en: scene ayalunch2r
: Uh-oh! Looks like it's weebnote time!
lines.zh: : 哎呀！看来是宅知识小课堂时间了！

lines.en: : What? Where did you come from?
lines.zh: : 什么？你从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: : Weebnote: Ramune, otherwise known as Japanese soda, is actually quite different from its American counterpart!
lines.zh: : 宅知识：弹珠汽水，也就是日式汽水，跟它的美式同类其实很不一样！

lines.en: : One of the key differences is the focus on more fruity flavors, some of which are very unusual by Western standards.
lines.zh: : 其中一个关键区别在于它更偏重果味，有些口味按西方的标准来看相当奇特。

lines.en: : You also need to carbonate them yourself by punching a tiny ball into an equally tiny hole. It’s mildly sexual and majorly delicious!
lines.zh: : 你还得自己给它打气——把一颗小珠子打进一个同样小的洞里。这有点色情，但超级好喝！

lines.en: scene ayalunch2r2
: That's weird...I could have sworn I...heard someone just now...
lines.zh: : 好奇怪……我明明……刚才好像听到有人说话……

lines.en: : Nope! I definitely didn't pay anyone to stand behind that board and shout out facts about Japanese culture to the void.
lines.zh: : 没有！我绝对没有花钱雇人站在那块板子后面，对着空气大喊日本文化小知识。

lines.en: : My gacha addiction lives to fight another day!
lines.zh: : 我的扭蛋瘾又能再战一天了！

lines.en: : ...Anyway, you don’t seem to have that much either, Sana. All I see is bread and rice.
lines.zh: : ……总之，Sana，你的看起来也不多啊。我只看到面包和米饭。

lines.en: : Are you on an all-carb diet or something?
lines.zh: : 你在进行纯碳水饮食之类的吗？

lines.en: scene ayalunch3
: Umm...no...I just...need the energy...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是……我只是……需要能量……

lines.en: : For {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 用来{i}干什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Umm...uhh...
: Living?...
: Sana doesn’t eat a lot, but whenever she does it’s pretty much all carbs.
lines.zh: : Sana 吃得不多，但只要吃，基本全是碳水。

lines.en: : Or candy.
lines.zh: : 或者糖。

lines.en: scene ayalunch4
: I have a problem...
lines.zh: : 我确实有问题……

lines.en: : I can see that. Your diet's even worse than mine.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来。你的饮食比我的还糟糕。

lines.en: : But, then again, I do have Ami making me breakfast and dinner pretty much every night and she forces me to eat vegetables.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我几乎每天早晚都有 Ami 做饭给我吃，而她会逼我吃蔬菜。

lines.en: scene ayalunch5
: Sensei! Did you know I can cook too?
lines.zh: : 老师！你知道我也会做饭吗？

lines.en: : Sana, tell Sensei how good of a cook I am.
lines.zh: : Sana，告诉老师我做饭有多好吃。

lines.en: scene ayalunch6
: Well...um...
: Ayane has...definitely cooked for me before, but...
lines.zh: : Ayane 确实……给我做过饭，但是……

lines.en: : ...But what?
lines.zh: : ……但是什么？

lines.en: : Umm...
: I’m...trying to think of the nicest way of saying it...
lines.zh: : 我……在想怎么用最好听的方式说出来……

lines.en: scene ayalunch7
: Don’t mind her, Sensei. She’s just a little traumatized from having to eat broccoli one time.
lines.zh: : 别理她，老师。她只是因为有一次被迫吃了西兰花，受了点心理创伤。

lines.en: : Food...shouldn’t look like a tree...
lines.zh: : 食物……不该长得像棵树……

lines.en: : Sana's kind of got a point, Ayane. It really shouldn't.
lines.zh: : Sana 说得有点道理，Ayane。确实不该。

lines.en: : In fact, I kind of like the idea behind the Sakakibara diet.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我还挺喜欢 Sakakibara 饮食法这个理念的。

lines.en: : If it were possible, I’d probably survive purely off of garlic bread anyway.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我大概光靠蒜香面包就能活下去。

lines.en: scene ayalunch8
: What? Why garlic bread of all things?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么偏偏是蒜香面包？

lines.en: : Well...
: It’s got garlic...and bread...
lines.zh: : 它有蒜……还有面包……

lines.en: : What more could you want out of a dish?
lines.zh: : 一道菜你还能要求什么？

lines.en: : It...can also have cheese too...and cheese is good...
lines.zh: : 还可以……加奶酪……奶酪也很好……

lines.en: : See? Sana understands.
lines.zh: : 看吧？Sana 懂。

lines.en: : I...will also survive off of garlic bread...if Sensei is going to do it...
lines.zh: : 如果老师要这么活……我也能靠蒜香面包活下去……

lines.en: : Well...what about pasta? That’s got garlic in it. And noodles are normally made out of bread or...wheat or something. Right?
lines.zh: : 那……意面呢？那里面也有蒜。而且面条一般是用面包……或者小麦什么的做的。对吧？

lines.en: : Do you want to try some of mine? I’ve only had a little.
lines.zh: : 你要不要尝尝我的？我才吃了一点。

lines.en: : No thanks. It's garlic bread only from now on and that's just not...bread enough.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。从现在起只吃蒜香面包，而那个……面包味不够。

lines.en: : Neither am I but you don't see {i}me{/i} complaining.
lines.zh: : 我的面包味也不够，但你没听见{i}我{/i}抱怨啊。

lines.en: : Ayane, please. There is a child present.
lines.zh: : Ayane，拜托。有小孩在场。

lines.en: scene ayalunch8r
: No there's not! Ayane is only a little bit older than me!
lines.zh: : 才没有！Ayane 只比我大一点点！

lines.en: : I'm going to have to see your ID, Sana. I'm not sure if I buy that.
lines.zh: : Sana，我得看看你的身份证。我不太确定我信不信。

lines.en: : I don't have an ID!
lines.zh: : 我没有身份证！

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 那是为什么？

lines.en: : Because I'm too y-
lines.zh: : 因为我太——

lines.en: scene ayalunch8r2
: B-Because I don't want one!
lines.zh: : 因……因为我不想要！

lines.en: : I'm not a child!
lines.zh: : 我不是小孩！

lines.en: : If you're not a kid, can you explain the joke I just made to us?
lines.zh: : 如果你不是小孩，能给我们解释一下我刚讲的那个笑话吗？

lines.en: scene ayalunch8r3
: No...I'm...taking a break from this conversation...
lines.zh: : 不……我……要退出这段对话了……

lines.en: scene ayalunch8r4
: Seriously, though. You should really try {i}my{/i} cooking sometime, Sensei. I can promise you that I'm just as good as Ami is. Maybe even better!
lines.zh: : 说真的，老师，你真该找个时间尝尝{i}我的{/i}手艺。我可以保证，我做的一点都不比 Ami 差。说不定更好！

lines.en: : I...don't know about that, Ayane. Ami is my personal chef and is fully aware of my tastes. I have a hard time imagining how you'd be able to beat her.
lines.zh: : 这个……我可不敢苟同，Ayane。Ami 是我的私人厨师，而且完全清楚我的口味。我很难想象你怎么能赢过她。

lines.en: scene ayalunch8r5
: Ami definitely knows her way around the kitchen...that I will concede.
lines.zh: : Ami 确实很会下厨……这一点我承认。

lines.en: : {i}But I know my way around your heart...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但我很清楚通往你心里的路……{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, I still don't see how that would help you win in a cook-off.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我依然看不出这能帮你在厨艺对决中取胜。

lines.en: scene ayalunch8r6
: Oh! A cook-off! That's a great idea, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦！厨艺对决！这主意太棒了，老师！

lines.en: : It wasn't really an idea. Just...kind of a thing I happened to say.
lines.zh: : 那不算什么主意。只是……我碰巧说出口的一句话。

lines.en: : Well, now it's an idea! A competition between friends and rivals! Not just for your stomach...but for your heart!
lines.zh: : 那它现在就是个主意了！一场朋友兼对手之间的比赛！不只为了你的胃……还为了你的心！

lines.en: : Is...Is Ami competing for your heart too, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 老师……Ami 也在争夺你的心吗？……

lines.en: More than you know, Sana....
lines.zh: 比你知道的还要多，Sana……

lines.en: : You'll...have to ask her that question. I refuse to speak about her motives.
lines.zh: : 这个……你得自己去问她。我拒绝谈论她的动机。

lines.en: : Do you think you'll be competing as well, Sana? I'd feel weird not letting you join in on this as well since you were here for the conception of it.
lines.zh: : 你觉得你也会参赛吗，Sana？你从一开始就见证了这事的诞生，不让你加入我会觉得过意不去。

lines.en: : ...Sana?
lines.zh: : ……Sana？

lines.en: : Sorry...I was just...trying to picture myself cooking and...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……我只是在……想象自己做饭的样子，然后……

lines.en: : It was just...darkness...
lines.zh: : 只有……一片黑暗……

lines.en: : Okay, so maybe Sana {i}won't{/i} cook, then.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那 Sana 大概就{i}不{/i}做饭了。

lines.en: scene ayalunch7
: Either way, I swear I’ll have you try my food eventually, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我发誓总有一天会让你尝到我的手艺，老师。

lines.en: : I don’t even care if I have to force-feed it to you.
lines.zh: : 就算得硬塞进你嘴里，我也不在乎。

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 求你别。

lines.en: : Actually, I think I’d prefer feeding you that way. It sounds like a nice bonding experience.
lines.zh: : 其实，我觉得我更喜欢用那种方式喂你。听起来是很棒的增进感情体验。

lines.en: : No. It doesn't.
lines.zh: : 不。一点都不。

lines.en: : Anyway, it's settled. One day soon, Ayane Amamiya will be cooking a gourmet dinner for both Sensei {i}and{/i} Sana. This time with no broccoli.
lines.zh: : 总之，就这么定了。不久的将来，Ayane Amamiya 要为老师{i}和{/i} Sana 做一顿大餐。这次没有西兰花。

lines.en: scene ayalunch10
: Huh?...Why am I...suddenly a part of this?...
lines.zh: : 哈？……我怎么……突然也卷进来了？……

lines.en: : You've been a part of it the whole time, silly.
lines.zh: : 你从头到尾都是其中一员呀，傻瓜。

lines.en: : Where would this...even take place?...There's nowhere to cook at the dorm...
lines.zh: : 那要……在哪儿做呢？……宿舍里没有能做饭的地方……

lines.en: : Sensei’s house, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是在老师家。

lines.en: : Are you just inviting yourself over without talking to Ami first?
lines.zh: : 你这是不打招呼就自己邀请上门，都没先跟 Ami 说一声？

lines.en: scene ayalunch11
: Of course. I do that all the time. She won’t care.
lines.zh: : 当然。我一直都这样。她不会介意的。

lines.en: : In fact, she’ll probably be happy so many people are over at once!
lines.zh: : 事实上，她大概还会因为一下子来了这么多人而高兴呢！

lines.en: : Sensei’s...house?...
lines.zh: : 老师的……家？……

lines.en: : Is there a problem, Sana?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗，Sana？

lines.en: : No, just...
lines.zh: : 没有，只是……

lines.en: : Is it...really okay?...For me to come over?
lines.zh: : 真的……可以吗？……我也能去？

lines.en: : Sure. I don't mind.
lines.zh: : 当然。我不介意。

lines.en: : Just don't blame me if Ami tries to kill either one of you for soaking up some of her alone time with me.
lines.zh: : 只是到时候 Ami 要是想杀了你们两个，因为你们抢走了一点她跟我独处的时间，可别怪我。

lines.en: : Don't worry, Sensei. Avoiding certain death in situations like that is one of my very many specialties.
lines.zh: : 别担心，老师。在这种情况下避开必死的结局，正是我众多专长之一。

lines.en: : I...guess that's that then.
lines.zh: : 我……想那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene ayalunch12
: That is that, indeed!
lines.zh: : 就是这样，没错！

lines.en: : The first annual ‘Ayane cooks for everyone including her future husband!’ event has been confirmed for...some time in the undetermined future!
lines.zh: : 首届「Ayane 为包括未来丈夫在内的所有人下厨！」活动已确定在……未来某个未定的时间举办！

lines.en: : Umm...congratulations...on your engagement...
lines.zh: : 嗯……恭喜……你们订婚……

lines.en: : I think...you'll make a good wife...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你会是个好妻子……

lines.en: scene black
The rest of the lunch period goes by pretty much the same way.
lines.zh: 午饭剩下的时间基本也是这么过去的。

lines.en: Ayane and Sana are an...interesting combination.
lines.zh: Ayane 和 Sana 是个……有趣的组合。

lines.en: I don’t think I’ll ever fully understand how the two of them wound up together, but...
lines.zh: 我想我永远也不会完全明白她们两个怎么会凑到一起，不过……

lines.en: I'm kind of glad that they did.
lines.zh: 我还挺庆幸她们凑到一起了。

lines.en: $ day54 = True
$ ayane_love += 1
$ sana_love += 1
{i}Ayane's affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sana's affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!{/i}
